text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference.  One original fictional adult man. Man with medium olive-brown skin, short wavy black hair and neat close beard, refined self-assured charm, black blazer over pale-gray open shirt. Facial design: broad square face, rounded jaw angles, slender arched brows, slightly close-set amber-brown eyes, short rounded nose, full bowed upper lip and medium lower lip. Handsome age 28. Black single-breasted blazer and matching straight trousers, pale-gray open-collar shirt, black leather derby shoes. Strong broad shoulders, tall 188cm build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
